DX_CAPABILITIES.title: Experience strategy
DX_CAPABILITIES.desc: Define the experience direction across products, services and digital touchpoints. Combine research, customer and employee needs, business goals and technology realities to prioritize where experience improvements can create the greatest value.

DX_CAPABILITIES.title: UX strategy
DX_CAPABILITIES.desc: Understand users, their needs and the journeys they take across digital touchpoints. Define information architecture, user flows, experience priorities and design direction that align customer needs with business goals.

DX_CAPABILITIES.title: UI design
DX_CAPABILITIES.desc: Create clear, consistent and accessible interfaces across web, mobile and digital platforms. Establish visual hierarchy, interaction patterns and responsive designs that make products easier to understand and use.

DX_CAPABILITIES.title: Product design
DX_CAPABILITIES.desc: Bring user needs, business priorities and technology together throughout the product lifecycle. From discovery and ideation to prototyping and validation, design products that solve the right problems and are ready to evolve.

DX_CAPABILITIES.title: Customer & employee experience
DX_CAPABILITIES.desc: Improve the journeys people take with the business, whether they are customers buying a product or employees completing work. Identify friction across touchpoints and workflows, then design simpler, more effective experiences.

DX_CAPABILITIES.title: Design systems
DX_CAPABILITIES.desc: Create reusable design foundations that bring consistency across products and teams. Establish components, patterns, guidelines and governance that improve quality while making design and development faster.

DX_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Reduce customer friction
DX_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Make it easier for customers to find, understand and complete what they need.

DX_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Create products and tools people can understand quickly and use with confidence.

DX_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Increase productivity
DX_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Simplify employee workflows and reduce the effort required to get work done.

DX_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Create consistency
DX_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Bring clarity and consistency across products, platforms and customer touchpoints.

DX_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Build better products
DX_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Turn user needs and business priorities into products that solve meaningful problems.

DX_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Design for change
DX_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Create flexible experience foundations that can evolve as products, users and business needs change.
